|game_text='''Dark Side:''' Your docking bay transit from here requires 2 Force. Your starfighters deploy -1 (or -2 if freighter) here. Immune to [Reflections 3] [[Ounee Ta]].

'''Light Side:''' May not be deployed to [[Bespin]], Dagobah, Endor, Hoth or [[Yavin 4 (V) (Virtual Block 7){{!}}Yavin 4]]. Your docking bay transit from here requires 3 Force. Your pilots deploy +1 here.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Spaceport: Docking Bay (V)]]; it is the current text. The image is the Master List slip, which prints it; the Players Committee card image and the release-sheet slip show the original text (see [[Spaceport: Docking Bay (V)]]).
* '''Original''' ([[Spaceport: Docking Bay (V)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 8.3 release sheet (official text as of 28 March 2013)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_3.pdf#page=3 Virtual Block 8.3 release sheet] ("Official text as of 28 March 2013"; the surviving copy was re-made 3 April 2013), page 3, slip 12 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095533/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_3.pdf#page=3 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Dark Side: Your docking bay transit from here requires 2 Force. Your starfighters deploy -1 (or -2 if freighter) here. Immune to [Reflections 3] Ounee Ta. Light Side: May not be deployed to Bespin, Dagobah, Endor, Hoth or Yavin 4. Your docking bay transit from here requires 3 Force.” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-p3-97-Spaceport_Docking_Bay.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-D-spaceportdockingbay-pre.gif]]) print it.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Dark Side p. 47)<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=47, page 47. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=47 Internet Archive]</ref> added “Your pilots deploy +1 here.” to the Light Side text: “Dark Side: Your docking bay transit from here requires 2 Force. Your starfighters deploy -1 (or -2 if freighter) here. Immune to [Reflections 3] Ounee Ta. Light Side: May not be deployed to Bespin, Dagobah, Endor, Hoth or Yavin 4. Your docking bay transit from here requires 3 Force. Your pilots deploy +1 here.” The Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1283-12-master.png]]) prints it.
